name: Neiro Music
description: Neiro Music — a block theme for a private music school in Ghent, founded in 2011, for children from five and adult beginners. An ink ground with bone-grey text; two overlapping portrait photographs open the page with a three-line Crimson Pro headline whose third line is indented; every section carries a vertical rail label; the teaching day is five stacked sticky rows (time, title, text, portrait) that cover one another as you scroll; a full-bleed parallax photograph of the Long Room, a full-width fee list in euro and pupils' stories as rows. Crimson Pro for headings and reading, Outfit for labels. Sample content in English. Works without WooCommerce. WCAG AA colours; scroll effects respect reduced motion.
